question: Must recitation with a hand-rosary proceed only in natural order?
premises: Recitation is prescribed as the action to be performed.
The hand-rosary serves as the instrument of recitation.
The recitation is restricted to the natural forward order.
inference: Therefore, one should recite using the hand-rosary only in natural order.
plain_english: And one should recite only in the natural order using the hand as a rosary.
